metadata.title: Woven Texture Soft Rock Album Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s-style layout featuring a central framed portrait set against a full-bleed diagonal herringbone woven texture, anchored by horizontal color bars and clean sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: 80s album layout with red and blue bars

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical rectangular portrait with a thin white border is layered over a light grey diagonal herringbone weave pattern. The top of the composition is dominated by a red horizontal banner containing large white text, underlined by a thinner dark blue bar. The bottom features spaced-out black text with small red square dividers.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait framed by a wide textured margin
Top-heavy typographic weight balanced by bottom-aligned subtitle
Geometric color blocks contrasting with organic woven texture
coreInvariants: Diagonal herringbone or wicker weave background
Thin white border around the central image
Primary color bars (red and dark blue) at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical rectangle, occupying approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red horizontal banner at the top containing the primary display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top banner down to the central portrait, finishing at the spaced subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The woven texture acts as the active negative space, providing depth and rhythm.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the geometric bars against a desaturated, neutral textured background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and tracking to establish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small red square glyphs as word dividers in subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, clean 80s editorial feel.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-frame diagonal herringbone woven wicker texture in light grey. Place a vertical rectangular portrait in the center with a thin white border. Add a thick red horizontal bar at the top and a thin navy blue bar immediately below it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white sans-serif uppercase text centered inside the red bar. Add smaller black sans-serif uppercase text at the bottom with extreme tracking and small red squares between words.

verificationChecks: Is the background a diagonal weave pattern?
Is the top text white on a red background?
Is the bottom text widely spaced with red dividers?
Is there a thin white border around the central image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific song titles or artist names

mustAchieve: Tactile quality in the woven background
High contrast between text and banners
avoid: Gradient fills in the color bars

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red bar is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the weave pattern is consistent across the entire background.
Verify the white border around the portrait is uniform.
Confirm the subtitle tracking is significantly wider than the display text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Woven Texture + Framed Portrait + Primary Color Header Bar + Spaced Subtitle
